content.description: Illustration of alternator stator showing coil leads and drive end frame

content.text: 2. INSPECT THAT STATOR IS NOT GROUNDED
Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between the coil leads and drive end frame. If there is continuity, replace the drive end frame assembly.

content.description: Illustration showing measurement of exposed brush length with a scale

content.text: Using a scale, measure the exposed brush length.
If the exposed length is less than minimum, replace the brush.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of brush and spring from brush holder

items: (a) Unsolder and remove the brush and the spring.
(b) Run the wire of the brush through the hole in the brush holder, and insert the spring and brush into the brush holder.

content.description: Illustration showing soldering of brush wire to brush holder at exposed length of 10.5 mm

items: (c) Solder the brush wire to the brush holder at the exposed length.
(d) Check that the brush moves smoothly in the brush holder.
(f) Apply insulation paint to the soldered point.

content.description: Illustration showing inspection of front bearing in alternator

content.text: Check that the front bearing is not rough or worn. Replace if necessary.
